subject.title: [Bug]: Slack channel history window is never cleared on reply; "Chat history since last reply" grows into a rolling buffer

question: Should Slack `requireMention: false` room history clear after a confirmed visible reply, or remain a rolling context window with corrected labeling/watermark semantics?
rationale: Current source, docs, tests, and the prior unmerged Slack history PR support rolling always-on context, while the prompt label and reporter expectation are reply-bounded; automation should not choose that user-visible behavior policy.

options.title: Clear after visible reply
options.body: Clear Slack always-on room history only after confirmed visible reply delivery, keeping quiet/no-reply context available until an actual reply boundary.

options.title: Keep rolling and relabel
options.body: Preserve the current rolling processed-message window but change prompt/docs wording so it no longer claims strict since-last-reply semantics.

options.title: Use self-watermark semantics
options.body: Record Slack outbound self entries and select history after the last self entry, closer to Telegram’s rolling-window model but with a larger implementation surface.

recommendation.title: Clear after visible reply
recommendation.body: Clear Slack always-on room history only after confirmed visible reply delivery, keeping quiet/no-reply context available until an actual reply boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest current-main ownership signal is the blame/path history across Slack prepare, shared channel-turn finalization, history helpers, and group docs.
